about: Input to scripts/images/prepare-photos.py. Every photo the site ships, where it came from, how it is cut, and what the privacy and accuracy review found. Sources are Kelvin's Drive folder 'website pictures' (zip of 4 Oct 2026), kept in the git-ignored media-inbox/drive/. Kelvin confirmed on 4 Oct 2026 that every photo is Nebsam's to publish and that anyone recognisable agreed to appear. 'origin' is what the image is, so a reader of this file never mistakes an illustration for a photograph: photograph (taken of a real place), manufacturer (the maker's or Nebsam's product shot), ai-generated (gap-fill under brief 3.6: never Nebsam staff, premises, vehicles or platform).

copied.from: the old site's public/images/main-entrance.jpeg, unchanged (1280x720, no EXIF); used since Sprint 12m, moved here in 12n
copied.review: The Mombasa branch entrance, Makupa. Kelvin, 4 Oct 2026: the old site's premises set is the Mombasa branch. Nobody in frame; the truck's plate is not visible. NOT made by the script, so a re-run never touches it.

photos.review: Generic articulated truck on a highway at dusk. No branding, blank plates, no people. Chosen by Kelvin over options 1 and 3 on 4 Oct 2026.

photos.src: Solutions/Vehicle tracking/Coastal Fleet Tracking in Mombasa.png
photos.review: Panel van on a coastal road. The box leaves out the mock 'Fleet Tracking' phone screen on the right, which would read as the Nebsam app (brief 3.6: AI never depicts the platform). Its leader line, which would now point at nothing, is healed out. The map pin over the van stays: it is a symbol, not data. Blank plate.

The Nairobi HQ, Kiambu Road. Three people in frame, each about 30px tall at full size, side-on or from behind: not identifiable. The car's rear plate and the motorbike's plate are blurred. The box trims the gravel foreground: it was most of the frame, and fine texture is what costs bytes on a branch card (Contact LCP, 12n).

The original is two photos side by side; the box keeps the shopfront. No people. The fascia sign prints 0769 063 333, which lib/company.ts gives as a Mombasa number, while the Nakuru card lists +254 725 221122 (register V89). The posters print 0759 000 111, the published WhatsApp number.

photos.review: The same source as home-solutions, cut for the solution page band: the mock phone screen is boxed out and its leader line healed out; the map pin over the van stays as a symbol. 3:2 rather than 21:9, because the van fills the height of what is left once the phone is cut away.

Two depot workers on radios, trucks behind. Kept by Kelvin (not among the seven left out). The laptop screen showed a fleet map that could read as the Nebsam platform (brief 3.6), so it is blurred. The cap carries a small white mark too small to read; no Nebsam branding anywhere.
